source_read.working_tree: clean (git status --porcelain empty), so every file read is the pinned blob
source_read.method: byte-level line count per file (count of \n, plus one if the file does not end with \n); no heuristic, no brace scan

scope.out_of_scope: every candidate with another stratum was ignored; no other file in the repository was written

method.span_check: for every judgement: start_line == 1 and end_line == the counted last line of the file at the pinned SHA
method.anchor_check: the anchor string was located in the file and its line recorded; all anchors are the package clause and all fall inside the span
method.grade_check: grade 3 only where the span is the whole of the file the query names; grade 1 only for sibling/twin files that are not the file asked for
method.stratum_check: every query string is a literal repository-relative path that exists at the pinned SHA
method.ambiguity_check: the only duplicated basenames in the cobra tree are _index.md and labeler.yml, so none of the eight bare-path queries is ambiguous
method.precedent_recheck: the four cobra-v2 exact_path grade-3 spans were re-counted independently: flag_groups.go 290, doc/man_docs.go 246, shell_completions.go 98, active_help.go 67 - all four equal the dataset values, confirming the whole-file convention is 'last line of the file'

verdicts.note: Span args.go:1-131 verified against the pinned checkout: 131 is the real last line (closing brace of the last declaration, file ends with a trailing newline). Anchor 'package cobra' present at line 15. Grade 3 matches the cb-07..cb-10 precedent for a bare-path query. Distractor args_test.go:1-541 verified (541 lines) and its reason is the verbatim cb-10 distractor wording. Review note, not a defect: the provenance claim 'no cobra-v2 exact_path row names args.go' is literally true, but args.go does carry many grade-2/grade-3 judgements in the ci-* config_docs rows of cobra-v2.json; a human should confirm that overlap is acceptable for a dev row.
